title: Concept: Weak Content-Security-Policy (unsafe-inline) header value
description: A script or style directive still lists 'unsafe-inline' and carries no nonce or hash, so inline code is accepted exactly as the keyword states. Inline code is the delivery form of most cross-site scripting payloads, which makes the keyword the difference between a policy that stops injection and one that only documents it.
risk: Inline script and style injection executes under the policy; LOW severity alone, because the policy is not the only control.
